B) I should have stopped after the Botox.

column2: ['What happened to the doctor?']
column3:
A) Until I recover, let's just assume your prostate is fine.
B) I guess I didn't explain the side effects, did I?

column2: ['Why is the horse wearing sunglasses in a dark room?', "Do the men know there's a horse at the table?"]
column3:
A) Because PETA said we can't whack him.
B) A bust is a bust, of course, of course.

column2: ['Why are there so many goats in the house?']
column3:
A) You're the one who left your fertility drugs on the counter!
B) No one said being goat foster parents would be easy.

column2: ['Why is the doctor an alien?']
column3:
A) I’m going to give you something for your humanity.
B) Sprained ankle, huh? Nothing a little probing can't fix.

column2: ['Why is the farmer in the city in the first place?', 'Why is he trying to get sheep onto the car?']
column3:
A) Come on! Do you have any idea how long it took to get through the turnstiles?
B) No, I'm not a shepherd. I'm the executive director of a traveling petting zoo.

column2: ['Why is the man so happy about this?']
column3:
A) The mileage is great but it handles a little rough.
B) About to land now, call you when I'm on the ground.

column2: ['Why is God or this large hand giving the man a sweater?']
column3:
A) Take it. You mother worries.
B) And above all, ALWAYS bring a sweater.

column2: ['Why did the man decide to do his cooking in the museum?', 'What is the man yelling at the guy on the left?']
column3:
A) I could've made that!
B) Rare works only!

column2: ['What would these animals have to say to one another?']
column3:
A) One of us is about to die.
B) Fish or fowl? I eschew labels.

column2: ['Why is the soldier wearing a receipt?']
column3:
A) That one is special. I received it for bringing in a multi-billion defense program on time and under budget.
B) You can't imagine what it's like to have someone stare at your chest and never look you in the eye.

column2: ['Why is there a moving skeleton?']
column3:
A) You're lucky to have gotten that space. People are just dying to get in here.
B) Of all the skeletons in all the world, I get stuck next to the one from my closet.

column2: ['Are the people on the bike speaking to each other on their cell phones?', 'Why would they choose a bike that long to ride?']
column3:
A) The restraining order really makes this awkward.
B) Well technically, you ran the red light.

column2: ['What did the shark do?']
column3:
A) Do YOU remember what you had for lunch last Thursday?
B) I'm not saying another word until I talk to a lure.

column2: ['Why is the bedroom in a cubicle office environment.']
column3:
A) Mom's moving in.
B) Try counting rats.

column2: ['Why is the ballerina part of the police lineup?']
column3:
A) It's Number Three, Officer. The thief had a small nose.
B) O.K., now we'd like to see No. 4 in the tutu.

column2: ['How are fish floating out of water?']
column3:
A) And the worst part is they're so depressed.
B) Just once, I'd like it to be fish and chips.

column2: ["Why is there a duck on the man's head?"]
column3:
A) I mean ... who are we to call someone crazy?
B) Don't worry, he's covered by Aflac.

column2: ['Why is the man cannonballing into the people?']
column3:
A) The memo said to 'expect incoming male' but we had assumed it was a typo
B) Sensing his job was at risk, Steve decided to make his value known by metaphor.

column2: ["Why is there a person dressed as a dog in a doctor's office?"]
column3:
A) Heal!
B) Say Arf.

column2: ['Why is the whale behind them?']
column3:
A) How could I know he's allergic to shellfish?
B) Then why did you have the bumper sticker?

column2: ['Did this guy think of that himself?']
column3:
A) Seriously? You've never tried a pair of hoveralls?
B) Because the airlines have jacked up their prices again.

column2: ['Why is there a devil in the church?']
column3:
A) There's one for you. Refuses to take his hat off in church.
B) I think it's important for them to hear both sides of the debate.

column2: ['Why is a pirate working at a restaurant?']
column3:
A) I like it. Since the anchor arrived, no one has asked about my hook, my hat, or what happened to the parrot.
B) One grande, half caf, skinny, soy, latte, extra foam, chai with a twist...and a sliced throat. Comin up.

column2: ['Why is there a huge anchor in a cafe?']
column3:
A) Complain all you want but I haven't lost a bathroom key yet.
B) Just a little insurance in case Trump is wrong about global warming.

column2: ['Why are they playing around like kids?']
column3:
A) It's a little creepy how Williams just sits there on the edge, watching.
B) At this stage of development, we find the girls are more socially advanced.

column2: ['Are they mummies or just heavily bandaged?']
column3:
A) It feels good to get out of the museum for a night.
B) It certainly wasn't MY idea to go to marriage counseling.

column2: ['Why are the people dressed as an angel and devil?']
column3:
A) You’re supposed to be on the other shoulder.
B) First hell froze over and now this...

column2: ['What is the statue smiling about?']
column3:
A) Ah, the innocence of youth.
B) His 401(k) must be in treasuries.

column2: ['Why are there people dancing on an office table?']
column3:
A) Go check the side effects on that flu vaccine.
B) Honestly, I’m not sure you’re partner material.

column2: ['Why is there a marching band leader leading these thirsty and tired men through the desert?']
column3:
A) It made so much sense four years ago.
B) This is my first mirage à trois, too.

column2: ['Where did the stick figure animals come from?']
column3:
A) Mom says they'll stick in your throat.
B) I'm really more of a painter-gatherer.

column2: ['Why are the cups so big?']
column3:
A) Welcome to Insomniacs Anonymous
B) Can you please pass the cow?

column2: ['What are the cavemen doing with those wheels?']
column3:
A) Why don't these come with instructions?
B) I think you just ate the spare.

column2: ['Why is there a church and hunchback in a modern city?']
column3:
A) I'm not kidding. It tolls for me.
B) Like I would date a guy from Notre Dame.

column2: ['What is the lion saying on the phone?', 'Who is the lion talking to?']
column3:
A) How many times do I have to tell you, don't call me at work!
B) yes we support public television,the check is in the mail.

column2: ['Why is the man in the tower with long hair not a woman like in the fable?']
column3:
A) When you pick up my birth control pills at CVS, don't forget my shampoo and conditioner.
B) My conditioner said it would give me extra body, but I didn't expect it to be yours.

column2: ['Who is the bartender calling?']
column3:
A) Stop me if you've heard this one.
B) Yes GOD, they all arrived safely.

column2: ['Why is the grim reaper dressed like a hoodlum?']
column3:
A) Well, if it isn't the Gym Reaper.
B) Couldn't we at least have dinner first?

column2: ['Why are there leaves growing out of the man?']
column3:
A) I also liked the Bernini exhibit.
B) You’re in luck! It's cannabis.

column2: ['Why is the cheerleader standing beside the plane?']
column3:
A) Taxi another 500 yards and check in with Tiffany.
B) Mom said you were supposed to take me to the game.

column2: ["Why is there a dinosaur biting the man's leg?"]
column3:
A) I wouldn't let him pose for the new mural.
B) The doctor said it will eventually just go extinct.

column2: ['Why is there a knight on a bike in modern times?']
column3:
A) On thy left, fair maiden.
B) I have a terrible horse allergy.

column2: ['Why are they still sitting in the water?']
column3:
A) Gore was right. This is inconvenient.
B) At least the kids are with the grandparents.

column2: ['How did the man shrink?']
column3:
A) He's the cutest little thing, and when you get tired of him you just flush him down the toilet.
B) No, they don't offer much in the way of companionship, but they're very low-maintenance.

column2: ['Why are there metal bars over the windows?']
column3:
A) It’s my first time on Celebrity Parole Hearing.
B) My secret? Good old fashioned butter.

column2: ['Why are they drinking and driving?']
column3:
A) I think we made a wrong turn at puberty.
B) Definitely a couple of suits, waiting to happen.

column2: ['What is the significance of the tank?']
column3:
A) And if you'll agree to drop the divorce proceedings and reconcile I'll throw in a pair of lobsters.
B) You'll find that a couple of hours in the Cool Whip vat will make you see things in a whole new light.

column2: ['Are they calling one another on the phone?']
column3:
A) The restraining order really makes this awkward.
B) Well technically, you ran the red light.

column2: ['Why are the Catholic, Protestant and Jew all hanging out together?']
column3:
A) It's gonna be one of those long nights of playing devil's advocate.
B) No, my refrigerator is not running, and that's the oldest joke in the book.

column2: ['Why are the giraffes tangled up like this?']
column3:
A) You always tend to overcomplicate things.
B) Please wag your tail, so I know which one is me.

column2: ['Why is this table so packed with people doing different things?']
column3:
A) No, sorry, the extroverts club meets on Tuesdays.
B) What makes you think we found your cat story boring?

column2: ['Why is there a shady looking guy behind the doctor?']
column3:
A) Instead of an expensive, invasive procedure, we've decided to beat it out of you.
B) "And don't bother getting a second opinion ... nobody has disagreed with me yet".

column2: ['What is the creature?', 'Why is the man arguing with the other man.']
column3:
A) Don't blame me—I voted for the other thing.
B) First a traffic study...now a science experiment!?

column2: ['Are they in an asylum?']
column3:
A) I admire your restraint.
B) They're gonna think we're nuts.

column2: ['Who is the bartender calling?']
column3:
A) I thought I told you to stop sending me jokes at work.
B) So then this three-legged dog comes into the bar.

column2: ['What are they doing?']
column3:
A) With the score tied love to love, Henry suddenly found himself inches away from the goal line.
B) Okay. Now you be the naughty mosquito, and I'll be the tormented sporting goods salesman.

column2: ['Why is there an election in heaven?']
column3:
A) I just don't care that much about Medicare anymore.
B) I suppose up here we have to take him at his word.

column2: ['Why is he playing an electric guitar?']
column3:
A) You played great in your dreams. Now come back to bed.
B) You know, dad, this is not making 'the talk' any less awkward.

column2: ['Why is he running on a hamster wheel?']
column3:
A) Same old same old. You?
B) No wonder this gym was so cheap.

column2: ['Why is he grilling on the train?']
column3:
A) Get your Prime here.....instant delivery and no annual fee.
B) If you want cheese, you'll have to stay on until 59th Street.

column2: ['Why is the soldier wearing a receipt?']
column3:
A) It's the price of freedom.
B) Are my secret codes showing again?

column2: ['How did the rat manage to build itself a jet pack?']
column3:
A) Exhibits inability to understand maze exercise.
B) I think Mr. Bezos will like these results.

column2: ['Why is the military there?']
column3:
A) Well, these Halliburton overseas assignments aren't what they used to be...
B) Tom, I think you should stop shouting ‘Bombs away!�?every time you drive the ball.

column2: ['Why is the horse wearing shoes?']
column3:
A) I don't think 'dressage' means what you think it means.
B) They don't have to match, they just have to go.

column2: ['What are they talking about?']
column3:
A) Well, I really must be staying.
B) Elizabeth said they're organic.

column2: ['Why did he attach drones to himself?']
column3:
A) Seriously? You've never tried a pair of hoveralls?
B) Because the airlines have jacked up their prices again.

column2: ['Why is the whale behind them?']
column3:
A) Trust me; in five years echolocation will have completely replaced GPS.
B) Can you believe Costco had this on sale for 99 cents per pound?

column2: ['Why is the man happy to jump the plank?']
column3:
A) Technically, he did walk it first.
B) Now, that's what I call execution.

column2: ['What is in the briefcase?']
column3:
A) Couldn't we have just written a check?
B) Not now—I'm in the middle of a big case.

column2: ['Why are the snowmen there?']
column3:
A) WebMD says that it's not a side effect.
B) Great, now they all want a scarf.

column2: ['Why is the ballerina angry?', 'Why is the ballerina in the bar?']
column3:
A) When people order a White Russian, that's not what they mean.
B) Honest to God, Joe, she's the best bouncer I've ever hired.

column2: ['How did he get cracked?']
column3:
A) You think this is bad? You should see what they do to non-whites.
B) I had a great fall, the greatest. No one fall has ever been greater

column2: ['How did the beach ball get so large?', 'Are there dead people under the ball?']
column3:
A) Yours is perfectly adequate.
B) What happened to the diving board?

column2: ['Why are there animals sitting in chaise longue sofas during a therapy session?', 'What is the man saying?']
column3:
A) I'm so glad to have found a family therapist I can work with.
B) I'm not comfortable discussing that in front of my fish.

column2: ['Why is there hell inside the house?']
column3:
A) They are willing to start negotiations at one soul.
B) The heating system is pretty old but very reliable.

column2: ['Where is the king going?']
column3:
A) You said Archie would be accepted in preschool.
B) Maybe His Highness should make reservations next time.

column2: ['Why are the neighbors in this suburban neighborhood defying gravity?', "Why is the wife's face spotted?"]
column3:
A) I wouldn't worry about rain if I were you.
B) Looks like they're ready to be flipped, Bob

column2: ['Why is that bird in his hair?']
column3:
A) Yes I have just come from the park. How can you tell?
B) Could you trim the sides but leave it feathered on top?

column2: ['Why is the golfer there?']
column3:
A) Sorry, but I have to play it where it lies.
B) No, a swing doctor isn't covered under Obamacare.

column2: ["Why is there a giant rat acting like a person in someone's house?", 'What is the woman saying and who is she calling?']
column3:
A) He's been on that same story for hours. I'm beginning to think he can't read.
B) Your mother says you turned into a pest when you got out of college, too.

column2: ['Why is the man sitting on a huge egg?']
column3:
A) Oh sure, when a MAN does it, suddenly it's such a big deal!
B) And to think they said we couldn't have kids past 40.

column2: ['What is the mobster trying to do to this man?', 'What is the mobster saying to the man?']
column3:
A) These shelter-in-place orders are really impacting my job performance.
B) Stop fighting it, kid—everyone eventually sings in the shower.

column2: ['What would a person want with a barrel of monkeys?']
column3:
A) The return address says U.S. government and no return,
B) They'd probably be more fun if the barrel had air holes.

column2: ['Why are there cacti next to that throne?']
column3:
A) Yes, Your Highness. The greatest threat is overwatering.
B) The gardener said they would make you seem more approachable

column2: ['Why is the meeting in the clouds?']
column3:
A) Keep climbing—you've only reached middle management.
B) Talk about a year of unprecedented growth.

column2: ['How did the man get stuck in the hair?']
column3:
A) If you were on time, it wouldn't be this long.
B) I never had this problem with Rapinzel.

column2: ['Why are the assitants there?']
column3:
A) Sometimes I wonder whether offering free Wi-Fi is such a good idea.
B) Let's face it. One side of the bed consistently outperforms the other.

column2: ['Why did the man turn into a couch?']
column3:
A) Peter, that is NOT what our therapist meant by "supportive.
B) My sister’s coming over. You could at least throw on a slipcover.

column2: ['Why is she having therapy in a living room?']
column3:
A) Yes, but they're watching a documentary on Monet.
B) I don't need therapy, I just need the remote!

column2: ['Why is the couch a monster?']
column3:
A) Yes, I know it's a sofa-bed, but...
B) I want to R-E-D-E-C-O-R-A-T-E.

column2: ["Why is the woman sitting like she's at a coffee shop inside of a cave?"]
column3:
A) I can evolve.
B) You dug them up?

column2: ['Was the man forced to go into the bath tub?']
column3:
A) The Sierra Club is definitely going to hear about this!
B) Some of my patients find the loofah less threatening.

column2: ['Why is the monster on the building?']
column3:
A) O.K. I'm at the window. To the right? Your right or my right?
B) And just what might these 'severe penalties for late payment' be?

column2: ['Why are they in a bowl?']
column3:
A) Some guys never make it out of the plastic bag.
B) You'd think they could just monitor our computers.

column2: ['Why is the office worker locked up in a stockade in a lobby?', 'What is the man saying to the woman?']
column3:
A) You should probably pass if they offer stock options.
B) He doesn't think our New Yorker cartoons are funny.

column2: ['What is that person doing with the flags?']
column3:
A) Yes, I understand. Many of my patients have difficulty talking about sex.
B) That's all well and good, Bob, but couldn't you just have sent me a text message?

column2: ['Why is the man so obsessed with his own image?']
column3:
A) I wish you’d go back to doing self-portraits.
B) Why do I feel I don't know the man I married?

column2: ['Why does the sun or moon have a face and why is it winking at them?']
column3:
A) I think he's been drinking the same stuff we have.
B) Remind me to close the curtains tonight.

column2: ['Why did the knight joust a car door?']
column3:
A) I take it you're not buying my door prize story.
B) I only glanced down at my phone for a second.

column2: ['Why is the bed above the bathtub?']
column3:
A) if we're going to go by the book, technically it's THREE men in the tub
B) Couldn't you just have had a last-meal request like everyone else?

column2: ['Why is there a man in a tub in a therapy office?']
column3:
A) I've combined my practice with Airbnb since your last visit.
B) I can give you the tools, but you have to do the work yourself.

column2: ['What are they discussing?']
column3:
A) I knew this day would eventually come.
B) So this is how the other half lives.

column2: ["What is the woman's interest/fetish, and why does she have it?"]
column3:
A) With the score tied love to love, Henry suddenly found himself inches away from the goal line.
B) Okay. Now you be the naughty mosquito, and I'll be the tormented sporting goods salesman.

column2: ["Why hasn't the man died from the snake being wrapped around him?", 'Why is the doctor dressed so informally?']
column3:
A) I've prescribed a new muscle relaxant for you
B) What we have here is a reptile dysfuntion.

column2: ['What is the woman saying to him?']
column3:
A) It made so much more sense in the infomercial.
B) I don't know what's going on either.

column2: ['Why does the jet have feet wearing high heels instead of landing gear?', 'What is the pilot saying to the aircraft marshal?']
column3:
A) Yes, our research and development is sponsored by Prada. How did you know?
B) It’s a pretty good aircraft, except that it keeps nagging you to ask for directions.

column2: ['What kind of organ is this?']
column3:
A) It's for when hell freezes over.
B) Frankly I'd prefer it in a lower register.

column2: ['Why is there a deer exhibit?']
column3:
A) It doesn't speak to me.
B) I was young and needed the money.

column2: ['Why is the man up there on the ceiling?']
column3:
A) Bob, we're not in Kansas anymore.
B) You're such a light sleeper.

column2: ['Why is there a man standing on the shark?', "What's the shark saying?"]
column3:
A) Lunch is on me.
B) They're better marinated.

column2: ['Why are they sleeping in a jail cell?']
column3:
A) My mother is coming to stay next week.
B) They don't even bother to give us an ashtray.

column2: ['What is the snowman doing?']
column3:
A) He took me back to his igloo, and let's just say he was abominable...
B) They didn't say who...they just said one of us won't be here in the spring...

column2: ['Why are the angels facing off?']
column3:
A) I didn't say Simon says.
B) I'm allergic to down.

column2: ['What is their conversation like?']
column3:
A) I keep forming inappropriate attachments.
B) Can we do another Rorschach test?

column2: ['Why is the shark trying to eat the mannequin?']
column3:
A) You're both dummies!
B) It's low cal...no dressing.

column2: ['Who is the girl on his forehead?', 'Why did he tattoo his forehead?']
column3:
A) On the bright side, mother will no longer accuse you of lacking commitment.
B) Well, it's a lovely gesture, but I still think we should start seeing other people.

column2: ['What is he trying to hatch?']
column3:
A) He's brooding again.
B) I do the night shift

column2: ['How did that shark get there?']
column3:
A) Really, voting him off the island was enough.
B) Here comes another one who didn't get the metaphor.

column2: ['Why is a UFO following a car?']
column3:
A) When they said, "Take us to your leader." I don't think they meant your mother's house.
B) Male creatures are all the same: give 'em a UFO, and the first thing they do is tailgate.

column2: ['Why is the hot dog so big?']
column3:
A) Mr. Trump is looking for examples of American exceptionalism.
B) You want to sell mustard? Here's how you sell mustard!

column2: ['Why are the cats piled up like this?']
column3:
A) Yes they're entertaining, but I'd prefer adopting from the local shelter, not Cirque du Soleil.
B) Yes, Officer, they say he was about six feet four, with pointy ears and abnormally short arms.

column2: ['How did the man get trapped?']
column3:
A) For God's sake, Dave, you're thirty-five—just use the stairs.
B) In hindsight, the mousse application probably wasn't the best idea.

column2: ['Why is his leg so long?']
column3:
A) You sure know how to impress a lady!
B) Another nasty hokeypokey injury!

column2: ['Why are the people under the desk?']
column3:
A) Tell them that the jury is still out.
B) Those white shoes make you look ridiculous.

column2: ['Why is the angel trying to hit the globe like a piñata?']
column3:
A) It's not the end of the world if he misses.
B) It's filled with styrofoam and plastic straws.

column2: ['Why is there a stick figure being interviewed for a job?']
column3:
A) On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate our weight loss program?
B) I'm sorry, this is Tic-Tac-Toe—applications for Hangman are down the hall.

column2: ['Why does the snake have a human butt.']
column3:
A) Please stop asking, honey. If anything, you look too thin.
B) She's been easily meeting all her project milestones

column2: ['Why is the book so big?', 'What is written in the book?']
column3:
A) You promised me you would stop after you lost your arm from that paper cut!
B) Sorry, dear, I just found out there already is a big book about Lyndon Johnson.

column2: ['Why do the trees have faces?']
column3:
A) They've been in love since 1992. I know. Their initials are carved in my ass.
B) Autumn: plaids, a path, a woman, a man, and trees with high foreheads.

column2: ['Why did the cat and piglets jump off the cliff?', 'What is the cat saying to the piglets?']
column3:
A) "Just to confirm—I get seventy-two lemmings, right?
B) It's ok, I lost my first life at your age too!

column2: ['How does the car operate with arms and legs instead of wheels?']
column3:
A) When there's a full moon, he drinks 93 unleaded, not 87.
B) What’s it going to take to get you in this car today?

column2: ['Why are there modern things in the scene?']
column3:
A) Maybe we should have just stayed home.
B) I knew I heard espresso shots.

column2: ['What happened to the doctor?']
column3:
A) Sorry, we're out of medical supplies.
B) I always wanted to do that.

column2: ['Why does heaven look like a prison?']
column3:
A) I'm about to go on break.
B) Anything to declare?

column2: ['Why are they eating at a subway?']
column3:
A) The lack of atmosphere won't last long
B) If you see something, say something.

column2: ['Why are the adults in the cages?']
column3:
A) Try to look housebroken.
B) I'm just happy I have a job.

column2: ['Why are there cave paintings of deer on the grass?']
column3:
A) Mom says they'll stick in your throat.
B) I'm really more of a painter-gatherer.

column2: ['Why are the mugs so big?']
column3:
A) Don't even think about bringing in a giant crumpet.
B) By a 9-0 vote, the restroom expansion project is approved.

column2: ['Why are the giraffes tangled up like this?']
column3:
A) Sometimes I just feel like my life is spiraling out of control.
B) If this shows up in National Geographic, we'll never hear the end of it.

column2: ['Why do they have strings?']
column3:
A) We've finally taken control of our lives.
B) This is why I suggested a threesome.

column2: ['Why is there a car in the house?']
column3:
A) I always tip a little extra for floor-to-floor service.
B) Why can't he take a limo like the rest of us?

column2: ['Why are the people dressed as an angel and devil?']
column3:
A) You’re supposed to be on the other shoulder.
B) First hell froze over and now this...

column2: ['Why are the men throwing thunderbolts?']
column3:
A) It's easy to kill from the clouds.
B) Ten bucks says you can't hit him twice.

column2: ['What happened to the man with tattered clothes?']
column3:
A) Relax, take off your shoe.
B) The bar is closed.

column2: ['Why are they all carrying the same suitcase?']
column3:
A) How did your interview go?
B) They only allow one carry-on.

column2: ['Why is the clown staring at the clerk?']

B) Please stop ignoring the gravity of your situation.

column2: ['Why is the room full of monkeys?']
column3:
A) If you can meditate here you can meditate anywhere.
B) Can we have one argument without you bringing up the monkeys?

column2: ['Why are there so many goats in the house?']
column3:
A) Could you bring me back a goat?
B) I know, I know. It's for the kids.

column2: ['What does this mean?']
column3:
A) Are you sure the boss is cool with this? It took him six days to make.
B) This ought to settle the Hollow Earth Theory once and for all.

column3:
A) You sure know how to impress a lady!
B) Another nasty hokeypokey injury!

column2: ['What is the other man saying to the man outside?']
column3:
A) The board just voted to remove the net.
B) I'm going out. You need anything?

column3:
A) And a Hurricane to drink, please.
B) Cancel the molten lava cake.

column2: ['Why does this soup bowl create its own weather?']
column3:
A) This isn't exactly what I meant when I said, 'Surprise me!'
B) You know what? Just bring me back the one with the fly in it.

column2: ['What are they talking about?']
column3:
A) It's not traditional, but I find it attracts a more mature type of female.
B) I've lost on all the last New Yorker cartoon captions. Maybe I'll win on this one!

column2: ['Why is he in the alley?']
column3:
A) They're called carbs. First stack is free.
B) Oh god, Jerry, enough, the divorce is final.

column2: ['Why is there a huge weight on the man?']
column3:
A) Anything you want to get off your chest, Carl?
B) The good news? You're not delusional.

column2: ['Why does the man have a giant weight on top of him.', 'What is the wife saying to her husband?']
column3:
A) I wish you'd come in when it was just a chip on your shoulder.
B) Easily the worst case of erectile dysfunction I've seen.

column2: ['Why are the grand pianos piled up together?']
column3:
A) It's not a happy room.
B) We buy everything in bulk.
